localizationOwnership: UI packages request exact t() keys in all10locale files; scheduler grants serialized locale ownership. Paths included in UI packet locks, no simultaneous locale write.
testOwnership: tests/macro-integration/ui/<screenid-lowercase>.spec.ts for primary UI owner; runtime helper/fixtures/shared snapshots reserved by integrator; all unplanned paths require ownership update.
screenFileAllocationRule: For collaboration implementationFiles.extend/new, primary UI owner gets exact paths as supplemental ownership. Original domainWorkPackageFiles remain their domain owner; shared canonical messaging/contracts.ts is reused, no parallel messages schema. Shared exact paths serialize via overlap leases. Screen owner is responsible for final interaction test while feature scope remains its WP slice.
